statementText: SELECT o.OrderId, p.Name, o.Total FROM dbo.Orders o JOIN dbo.OrderProducts op ON o.OrderId = op.OrderId JOIN dbo.Products p ON op.ProductId = p.ProductId WHERE o.Status = 'completed' AND p.Category = 'Electronics'

reasons: Scan on dbo.Products with join predicate on (Category) is part of a Nested Loops join and is ~33% of statement cost. An index on the join predicate columns would eliminate the full scan.
